questions.q1: Which pitches are attacked (grace notes excluded) in voice 4.1 of bar 5 at offset 6? A list, low to high.
questions.q2: What is the lowest pitch sounding at the very start (offset 0) of bar 10, in any staff (grace notes excluded)?
questions.q3: What is the highest pitch attacked in bar 9, across all staves (grace notes excluded)?
questions.q4: List every bar (other than bar 1) in which voice 4.1 is identical (same notes and durations) to voice 4.1 of bar 1.
questions.q5: How many notes are attacked in staff 1 of bar 8, all voices of that staff? Count each note of a chord separately; exclude grace notes.
questions.q6: In voice 4.1, across bars 5 to 8, what are the lowest and the highest pitch (grace notes excluded)? As {"low": …, "high": …}.
questions.q7: How many times is the pitch D3 attacked in voice 4.1 in bars 8 and 9 together (grace notes excluded)?
questions.q8: List the attacks of voice 1.1 in bar 9 in order (grace notes excluded); write a chord as its pitches joined by + low to high, e.g. "C4+E4".
